Class ServerResponse<T>

java.lang.Object
com.supermarketstore.protocol.ServerResponse<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the response data payload
public class ServerResponse<T> extends Object
Represents a standard JSON response sent from the server to a client.

      public ServerResponse()
      Creates an empty response. Required for Jackson deserialisation.

    • ServerResponse

      public ServerResponse(String status, String message, T data)
      Creates a response with a status, message, and data payload.
      Parameters:
      status - Typically "OK" or "ERROR".
      message - Human-readable response message.
      data - Optional payload data.
